bounded_credential_review.limit: Pattern/field review, not a universal secret-detection guarantee.

environment.scope: operator Python backend; completed jobs; warm observations; normal controller restart
environment.transport: native stdio MCP, one concurrent session per controller

first_campaign_comparison.design_difference: First campaign C4 followed its C1 cell. This independent C4-only ABBA follows only preflight. Both use 96 calls/cell, two rounds/version, two Tokio workers and the same runtime hashes.
first_campaign_comparison.interpretation: First-campaign C4 p95 +20.900% is retained and not reproduced directionally by recheck p95 -2.249%. Throughput declines in both, narrowing from -3.713% to -0.300%; CPU/call increases in both (+1.097%, +1.253%). This is neither universal no-regression evidence nor proof of a stable 20.900% regression.

interpretation: Independent C4-only ABBA recheck: small throughput decline and CPU/call increase; p50 and p95 improve. First-campaign evidence remains separate. The first p95 regression does not repeat directionally; neither campaign establishes causality or statistical confidence.

invariants.per_round_receipt_check_scope: The reviewed harness checks source receipt bytes and copied controller receipt bytes before setting each round.passed; raw ABBA does not contain separate after-file bytes.
invariants.source_check_meaning: ABBA source_originals_unchanged means six frozen job-receipt files, not a Rust source tree. Separate archived qualifications bind both runtime hashes to unchanged tested Rust source maps.

method.calls_per_second: sum(all measured call rows) / sum(the two same-version cell seconds); not an arithmetic mean of cell rates.
method.cell_wall_time: Includes thread pool creation/drain; excludes initialization, output preflight, shutdown and restart probes.
method.controller_cpu_ms_per_call: 1000 * sum(controller_cpu_seconds) / sum(all measured call rows); same PID and birth ticks at the harness utime+stime endpoints.
method.cpu_scope: Controller process only, including its background work during the cell; excludes SSH descendants, remote helpers and Python benchmark driver.
method.independent_recomputation_boundary: Counts, balance, pooled raw latencies and aggregates recomputed from recorded rows/deltas. Response identity/output checks compare recorded digests and lengths; complete returned DTO validation was performed by the reviewed harness.
method.latency_quantiles: Pool all 192 elapsed_ms values for each version/concurrency; nearest rank sorted[ceil(p*n)-1]. Do not average per-cell quantiles.
method.row_latency: Starts inside the worker before tools/call; includes RPC serialization, transport, response handling and validation, but excludes time queued before worker execution.

not_covered: controller SIGKILL in this observation ABBA

provenance.archive_scope: Report JSON only; no profile, ssh_config or known_hosts file contents.

resource_observation.interpretation: Whole-controller-lifetime RSS/FD/tree CPU samples cannot be allocated to individual concurrency cells. Missing samples and recorded FD permission errors preclude a clean resource-reduction claim. The direct cell controller CPU deltas are separate from the tree sampler.
resource_observation.per_cell_sampled_tree_cpu_delta_caveat: The raw report labels asynchronous snapshot differences as lower bounds, but boundary error can have either sign: pre-cell work can enter the later sample and endpoint work can be missed. These deltas are preserved, not used as CPU/call evidence.
